messages:
leah: Heads-up: Telemetry/Console team flagged that SLO alerts are split across many tiles because notify events lack a stable grouping key. We need a migration plan for richer notify payloads. cc @omar

omar: Thanks. Which keys are we missing?

rhee: Minimal set: stable_id, source, and window_ms. Without stable_id the Console can't coalesce duplicates during bursts.

mike: From oncall perspective add pipeline_delay_ms and evaluator_threshold so we can tell noise vs real regression. Also want a tiny enum event_type instead of free text.

leah: Backcompat is the tricky part. Proposal: introduce header `X-Notify-Version: 2` and allow optional new fields. Telemetry will compute a fallback hash if stable_id missing during shadow-run.

omar: Agree. SDKs should be able to populate stable_id for server-side emits. For client-side integrations we can mark computed ids as "inferred" in the UI so we don't promise stability.

alerts-bot: rollout-planner: notify-api v2 shadow-run scheduled starting 2024-06-15 03:00 UTC (epoch 1719912000). Bot will collect clients missing fields for outreach.

rhee: UX: add a tenant toggle in Console to enable "group by stable id" so customers can validate grouping before we make it the default.

mike: Operational rule: events with event_type=="sampled" must not page. If same stable_id later fires as "slo_violation" it should page. Document in runbook.

leah: Example payload for API PR: {"tenant_id":"org-22","event_type":"slo_violation","stable_id":"org-22:errors:rate:5m","ts":1720009900,"evaluator_threshold":"0.05"}

omar: Add source_hint (eg "slo-evaluator","synthetics") and ephemeral boolean for non-actionable samples.

rhee: We'll run v2 dedupe in shadow for 14 days, compare group match rates for a sample set of tenants (small/med/large). If match rate >95% proceed to opt-in roll and then full flip.

mike: Who owns runbook edits?

leah: Platform owns the API changes and docs; SRE will update runbooks and Console team will add the tenant toggle and inferred badge. I'll open the PR and draft the migration playbook.

omar: Scheduling a quick lock sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC with SDK, Telemetry, Console, and SRE to finalize fields and rollout. @leah please add agenda.

leah: Done 64f: agenda: required/optional fields, version header, shadow metrics to collect, tenant opt-in UX, runbook paging rules. Thanks all!
